sch: Tier-3 video assessment (analyst: Jim Totime, single scout) of a young Romelu Lukaku's 2009-2010 Anderlecht season (age 16), source: Empire_FGA_Video_Scoring_Romelu_Lukaku_2009_2010.xlsx -- part of Jim's stated 'ESN Player-Legend Comparison Series -- Madjo/Lukaku pairing' project. Foundation: only OTP clears its own ≥3-event bar; RDS/UNP/DGP/MRK do not (≥3-distinct-match test). 8/12 core metrics graded (VIDEO COMPLETENESS). 1 scout (Jim Totime) -- fails v4.0's 2-scout SCOUT_VALIDATED bar.
